title: Baby-G Women Digital Watch BGD-10KG-2DR
description:
Mix and match, shimmer and shine! The retro-pop translucent BABY-G+ PLUS with glittering dial is all about Y2K sparkle.

Wear it as a wristwatch or place the center case into the holder, turning the watch into a unique time-telling charm. Decorate the silicone holder to really make it your own. Add a touch of see-through color and glitter to your style with a whimsical retro-pop look reminiscent of 90s gadgets.

More than a sparkling accessory, these watches also deliver shock-resistant construction, 100-meter water resistance, and practical utility, all to keep up with your active days.

* Customers bear responsibility for decorations applied to the holder.

Notes on custom holder with strap
• The amount of glitter may vary from watch to watch and glitter may be unevenly distributed within the same watch due to details of the manufacturing process.
• Avoid storing in direct sunlight, high temperatures, or high humidity.
• Attaching a metallic strap may damage the strap holes.
